description:
Add the lodash tests for both `head` and `tail` following this guideline https://github.com/toss/es-toolkit/issues/235:
- `head`: https://github.com/lodash/lodash/blob/6a2cc1dfcf7634fea70d1bc5bd22db453df67b42/test/head.spec.js#L1
- `tail`: https://github.com/lodash/lodash/blob/6a2cc1dfcf7634fea70d1bc5bd22db453df67b42/test/tail.spec.js#L1
